I’ve been reading a lot of grabedancing and “why Orbio/AI/insertnotyourbagshere” dead on the timeline this week.
 
The answer is simple: because every single rh top coin - and onchain at large - also collapsed the same amount.

In order of drawdown, ballparking roughly for top mcap coins:

Cashcat -60%
Pons -70%
Orbio -75%
Ai -75%
Stonkbrokers -85%
Netnet -90%

Orbio just got more hate because most people don’t have the attention span for complexities so faded and missed the run, and by consequence enjoy hating on it more. 

And incidentally, that’s the fall of every other “onchain gem” in other top ecosystems like stonks, where most actually did worse. Most solana coins went to litteral zero in two weeks, with flagbearers allinu and zcat and mask on the magical -70% ish number. Ansem, one of the best performing pump big caps, also down, you guessed it, around 60/70% from top. Same for Crawl, who I still think is a supercool concept. And an insane amount to litteral zero, tens of thousands in that wasteland. 

Most bnb coins went to litteral zero too, with a speed and brutality and arbitrary kingmaking and numbers that are mind numbing: niu lai and marscoin most resilient flagbearers and hitting that same 60/70%.

Mainnet renaissance brought  hooks, most good ones are down, guess what: 70%. Just like Claus wich is the coolest thing to spawn in months, and CT darlings like Zipcoin now -95% and counting.

It’s litterally the same everywhere you look, the only difference is mental inelasticity and the intellectual dishonesty of people yapping for elon bucks. Combined with the ubiquotous omnipresent bag bias. Ct just has this pvp mentality ingrained real fucking deep so if it’s not “my bags” then it’s time to I told you so and act like everything else is also not in the same shape or worse. Wich is a cancer in culture just as much as the endless trenching bundle revolting hideous parade on display of late. Tell ya what, constantly ragging on shit doesn’t make your bags look better. Especially when you’re hating on shit that is actually trying. I think Long eco is actually trying. I think hook innovators are actually trying.

Here’s the thing. 

These assets went for parabolic runs. Every cycle there are 70% plus corrections on ‘em. Multiples, at that, so get ready cause it’s a long road and uncomfortable road to making it. Check any onchain darling that made it to multiple billions in any cycle. 

Most of this shit will never recover, know that. The ones that will, will retire bloodlines from here. As usual, my bets tend to be unchanged, and are the ones that do show ambitious complexeties, or unvampable concepts or culture and communities now trialled by fire. 

Good luck out there, and spare some nonsense on the timeline: your bag bias and elon bucks pan handling is showing.
